message.content: The worker processes failed because the NPZ file was being read lazily from several processes at once. I'll load the table arrays eagerly and rerun.
message.reasoning: NpzFile's lazy loading isn't safe across threads or processes, so I should fix this by eagerly loading all arrays into a plain dict at module import time instead, making sure that happens fresh in each process.
